name: @agentsviz/integration
description: End-to-end integration test: simulates a real multi-agent run through the instrumentation helper against the real event server, and asserts the server's state store reflects it accurately.

scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix ../instrumentation install && npm --prefix ../instrumentation run build && npm --prefix ../server install && npm --prefix ../server run build && node e2e-test.mjs
scripts.test:hooks-emitter: npm --prefix ../hooks-emitter install && npm --prefix ../hooks-emitter run build && npm --prefix ../server install && npm --prefix ../server run build && node hooks-emitter-e2e-test.mjs
scripts.test:stale-agent: npm --prefix ../server install && npm --prefix ../server run build && node stale-agent-e2e-test.mjs
scripts.test:persistence: npm --prefix ../server install && npm --prefix ../server run build && node persistence-e2e-test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:hooks-emitter && npm run test:stale-agent && npm run test:persistence
